notes.title: Wizabeasts release!
notes.notes: [p]Today is the release day for Wizabeasts! It will be released shortly. I've been working on this passion project for a while, and I hope you like it. :)[/p][p][/p][p]Also, I've uploaded the music from the game on YouTube.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VGSRxS4lY8w"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Wizabeasts is part of Creature Collector Fest 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548190/f546cc392fdbc3fb710770610778c82682d2774a.png[/img]
Wizabeasts is part of Steam's Creature Collector Fest 2025 event, which began today! During the duration of the festival, a demo for the game will be available to play.

notes.title: Wizabeasts is part of Steam Next Fest (2024 October)!
notes.notes: Wizabeasts has an available demo for Steam Next Fest (October 2024)! In the start menu and world menu in-game, there is a button called "feedback" which links to a form where you can provide feedback. If you give the demo a try, I would love to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: Wizabeasts will be part of Gym Leader Ed's Monster Taming Direct (2024 Sep 2)!
notes.notes: Popular monster-taming YouTuber Gym Leader Ed (working with Berry Bandit) is hosting the 2024 edition of the Monster Taming Direct. I'm excited to announce that Wizabeasts will be featured in the direct! If you enjoy monster-taming games, you should definitely check it out: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bjca8IIu0YQ

notes.title: Wizabeasts will be part of RPG Direct on July 27th!
notes.notes: Wizabeasts will be one of the games taking part in RPG Direct, starting on July 27th! You can check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/nokogodo/sale/RPG

notes.title: Wizabeasts is joining PixElated Fest on July 29th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43548190/6b51b915de98145d853754c62ebd8f225eb8637e.png[/img]

We love pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 We’re super excited to share that Wizabeasts joins PixElated Festival next week! This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!
There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite games.
Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/
